program.name: HIIT Mix
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Two HIIT formats each day: an EMOM then a Tabata, or a circuit then a ladder.
program.about: Each day joins two formats so the effort changes halfway. One day is an EMOM followed by a Tabata; the other a circuit followed by a ladder. Your body never quite settles into a rhythm, which is the point. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
